integrity: The proof analytically reduces the source's two-parameter maximization to its saturation boundary, then factors the boundary defect and identifies the unique symmetric optimizer. The packaged numerical grid is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The result evaluates the explicit upper-bound maximization in Remark 7.3 only for 1-1/(2sqrt(2)) <= sigma < 1. It does not assert that the bound is operationally tight, and it does not analyze lower-soundness regimes where other exact product-test pieces enter.
title: Closed-form high-soundness optimization of the exact product-test QMA conversion bound
